title: biosig-zarr format version 2: view array metadata document
description: The zarr.json of one view level (a downsampled minimum and maximum envelope of level 0, for rendering only) of a channel group in a format version 2 store, transcribed from spec/index.md at release 2.0.0, which is the definition. Rules that relate two values, such as the length of a level and the one below it, are not expressed. Attributes the text lists as possibly absent in a version 2 store are not required, and unknown attributes are allowed.
$comment: View pyramid: the view arrays a group's view_levels lists.

zarr_format.$comment: Zarr requirements: a store MUST NOT use Zarr version 2 metadata.

node_type.$comment: View pyramid: a view level is an array.

data_type.$comment: View pyramid: the same data type as level 0, which Level-0 array says MUST be int16 or float32.

shape.$comment: View pyramid: shape [2, n_channels, n_L]; along axis 0, index 0 is the minimum and index 1 is the maximum.

prefixItems.$comment: View pyramid: axis 0 has the minimum and the maximum.

codecs.$comment: View pyramid: view arrays are not sharded, and the chain is bytes with little-endian byte order, then blosc with the zstd compressor.

bytesLittle.$comment: View pyramid: bytes with little-endian byte order.

bloscZstd.$comment: View pyramid: blosc with the zstd compressor.

attributes.$comment: View pyramid: the REQUIRED rows of the view array attribute table, less chunk_columns, which What changes the version lists as possibly absent.

level.description: View pyramid: the level number, 1 or greater.
